section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential
title: DISASSEMBLY OF DIFFERENTIAL

content.heading: REMOVE DIFFERENTIAL CARRIER COVER
content.text: Remove the eight bolts, cover and gasket.

content.heading: REMOVE SIDE GEAR SHAFT
content.text: Using SST, remove the side gear shaft from the differential carrier.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of side gear shaft from differential carrier using SST tool

content.heading: REMOVE SIDE GEAR SHAFT OIL SEAL
content.text: Using SST, remove the oil seal.

content.description: Illustration showing removal of side gear shaft oil seal using SST tool

content.heading: CHECK RING GEAR RUNOUT
content.text: If the runout is greater than maximum, install a new ring gear.

content.description: Illustration showing ring gear runout measurement on differential carrier

content.heading: CHECK RING GEAR BACKLASH
content.text: If the backlash is not within specification, adjust the side bearing preload or repair as necessary. (See page RA-32)

content.description: Illustration showing ring gear backlash measurement on differential carrier
